turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Hi, Sam. How did your shift at the store go today?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hey Wren. Oh, you know, standard Monday inventory chaos, but something really unexpected popped up during my lunch break.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: A lunch break surprise sounds intriguing. What happened?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So remember Vantlow Software, who passed on me last month? Well, their recruiter actually reached back out to me today about a customer success associate role.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is quite a twist after their rejection. How did you feel seeing their name in your inbox again?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Honestly, totally stunned. I really thought that ship had sailed for good, especially when I was worrying my retail background scared them off.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: It turns out your retail work didn't count you out after all. Did the recruiter say what the next steps look like?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, she just asked if I'd be up for a short catch-up call later in the week to talk through the new position.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: That is very encouraging news. Do you want to move forward with them?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I think so, yeah. Since Pellwick moved my final round, having Vantlow back on the table gives me another solid option.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Keeping multiple paths open takes some pressure off. How are you feeling about juggling both of them while working full-time?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I mean, I'm definitely tired, but having two places interested feels a whole lot better than zero.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: It definitely gives you some breathing room. Do you want to run through any talking points before that phone screen?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not tonight, honestly. I kind of just want to chill and eat dinner, maybe prep a bit closer to Thursday.

turns.speaker: wren
turns.text: Rest is an important part of the process too. Are you heading offline for the evening?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yeah, closing the laptop and taking a real break. Thanks for listening, Wren.
